run_modular_addition_training: run the modular addition neural network training with configurable epochs, learning rate, and optimizer via argparse
generate_dataset_modular_addition: generate a complete modular addition dataset for a given modulus M with all input pairs and labels
test_model_accuracy: test a trained ModularAdditionNN model on input tensors and return per-output accuracy scores
build_modular_addition_nn: build a ModularAdditionNN PyTorch model with configurable embedding dimension, hidden size, activation, and batch norm
refactor_modular_addition_nn_forward: refactor the ModularAdditionNN forward pass to support additional activation functions or output layer configurations
